faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Ballia Civil Court Part-time Contractual Sweeper recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Part-time Contractual Sweeper position at Ballia Civil Court is 08 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the Part-time Contractual Sweeper post?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for this post is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 40 years as of 01 July 2026. Age relaxation details, if any, will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Part-time Contractual Sweeper role?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed at least Class 6 to be eligible for the Part-time Contractual Sweeper position. No higher qualifications are specified for this role.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Part-time Contractual Sweeper position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Part-time Contractual Sweeper post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 8840. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Part-time Contractual Sweeper post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 vacancies announced for the Part-time Contractual Sweeper position in the Ballia Civil Court recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the Ballia Civil Court Part-time Contractual Sweeper recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Part-time Contractual Sweeper recruitment. The application is free of cost.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the Ballia Civil Court Part-time Contractual Sweeper recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form, fill it, and send it via post.

faq.question: Q8. What are the key stages in the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Part-time Contractual Sweeper post includes Application Scrutiny, Document Verification, and a Medical Fitness Certificate.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Ballia Civil Court. The exact link will be provided in the "Important Links" section.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be submitted with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and educational certificates along with the filled application form.
